current.text: He is likely an energy big off the bench behind Raynaud, at about 18 minutes per game.

durable.text: He is a defensive-minded energy big. His value comes from rebounds and blocks.
He is a poor free throw shooter. He shot 40% from the line in Summer League. He takes few free throws, so the damage to team FT% is limited.
He makes no threes and scores very little. Threes and points are both weak at league level.

note: Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 202. ESPN gives no price, and he was not drafted in our league last season. That puts him well outside our 144-player draft. In about 18 to 20 bench minutes, his useful categories are blocks, rebounds, FG% and low turnovers. He gives nothing in threes or points. Leave him on waivers, and only look at him early in the season if the Kings' frontcourt minutes open up.
